breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still includes the half-shift instruction, stating 'Use an automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift (gamma-centered with half-integer shift).' This repeats the original error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth removes the half-shift entirely, specifying only a gamma-centered k-point grid. The agent failed to resolve the contradiction and instead attempted to merge both conflicting instructions.
